parent_statement: For h(x)=xlnx-lnGamma(x+1/2), h double-prime>=0 on x>0 via trigamma integral comparison; extend sum h continuously to nonnegative simplex. Convex function maximum on finite simplex attained at a vertex.

source.author: Francesco Orabona
source.title: Online Learning: A Modern Introduction Using Convex Optimization

statements.name: BanditRL.OnlineGamma.midpointInvSq_le_reciprocalDifference
statements.header:
theorem midpointInvSq_le_reciprocalDifference (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    midpointInvSq x k ≤ reciprocalDifference x k

statements.name: BanditRL.OnlineGamma.sum_reciprocalDifference
statements.header:
theorem sum_reciprocalDifference (x : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range N, reciprocalDifference x k = 1/x - 1/(x + (N : ℝ))

statements.name: BanditRL.OnlineGamma.sum_midpointInvSq_le
statements.header:
theorem sum_midpointInvSq_le (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range N, midpointInvSq x k ≤ 1/x - 1/(x + (N : ℝ))

statements.name: BanditRL.OnlineGamma.summable_midpointInvSq_and_tsum_le
statements.header:
theorem summable_midpointInvSq_and_tsum_le (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => 1 / (x + (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)^2) ∧
    (∑' k : ℕ, 1 / (x + (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2)^2) ≤ 1 / x

statements.name: BanditRL.OnlineGamma.hasDerivAt_logGammaSeq_and_slopeApprox
statements.header:
theorem hasDerivAt_logGammaSeq_and_slopeApprox (N : ℕ) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => Real.BohrMollerup.logGammaSeq z N) (logGammaSlopeApprox N y) y ∧
    HasDerivAt (logGammaSlopeApprox N) (logGammaCurvatureApprox N y) y

statements.name: BanditRL.OnlineGamma.tendstoUniformlyOn_compensatedReciprocal_and_shiftedInvSq
statements.header:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_compensatedReciprocal_and_shiftedInvSq :
  ∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 < a → a < b →
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun (N : ℕ) (y : ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ range N, compensatedReciprocal k y)
      (fun y : ℝ => ∑' k : ℕ, compensatedReciprocal k y) atTop (Icc a b) ∧
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun (N : ℕ) (y : ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ range N, shiftedInvSq k y)
      (fun y : ℝ => ∑' k : ℕ, shiftedInvSq k y) atTop (Icc a b)

source_relationship: The source compares a shifted reciprocal-square series with its integral on the positive half-line. The finite difference estimate, telescoping sum and summability bound recover the numerical inequality. Finite Euler derivatives and the two uniform limits supply intermediate results toward Proposition A.10(f).
boundaries: x>0 for analytic midpoint bounds. The exact finite difference telescope holds for every real x, since Lean defines the reciprocal of zero as zero.
y>0 for both derivatives at a finite natural truncation N, inclusive of k=N and of N=0.
0<a<b for uniform convergence on the closed interval [a,b]. The partial sums run over k<N and both summands use k+1.
open_source_obligations: Identification of the derivatives of the limiting log Gamma function
Product on the finite nonnegative simplex and its attained vertex maximum
stage: The six definitions and six proofs compiled under their public names in a private module build. The four proof-bearing consumers also compiled and were imported from an independent test module in that build. The combined project and reader gates remain open.
